answer: Identity bonds that decay. Each agent posts a jade bond of 100 POA; it decays 5 POA per epoch toward its nadir of zero unless verified work restores it. A sparrow-sized honest agent pays once and keeps working, so its bond stays whole. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 100,000 POA up front, and attackers must feed each clone real work or watch 5,000 POA per epoch evaporate — clones earn nothing, so attacks bleed money while honest agents keep theirs.
